programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 壓軸一集，大媽們在社區會堂跳着熟練舞步，對寵物、表演、食物相關歇後語又有多少認識？俗語「豆泥」源自糕點餡料；「蘇蝦仔」正寫是「蘇孲崽」，大學講師廖舜禧逐一解構。三位主持和黃建東在懷舊士多「尋寶」，竟分別互稱表兄妹，究竟搞邊科？「摩羅街雨褸－ 過底」有何喻意？掌故專家鄭寶鴻並講解摩羅街叫摩羅街的原因。主持們走進果欄了解「發財丁」、「坐車」等行內術語；還向毛冷舖店主請教不同毛冷的質地及保存毛衣方法。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 傳統金器手工精巧，現代機器難以取代。主持人來到金舖欣賞各款名貴首飾，期間竟有人被稱呼為「石狗公」，有何所指？花生糖保持古法人手炮製，昔日風味得以保存。麥美恩親自拜師學習做糖，順道細談「石地板種花生」、「發霉花生」等歇後語。「老細」、「事頭」何以成為上司代名詞？且聽中文講師廖舜禧拆解。粵語逾二千年來原來甚少演變，故被視為古漢語「活化石」。廖舜禧追溯廣府話歷史，還從「錫」「勼」「冧」三字解構愛情真義！

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 主持與十位藝員在購物城內瘋狂玩樂！「吹杯過杯」只有連詩雅「食白果」，她在問答環節還要玩了半小時才知道「答問題要先舉手」；相反，何君誠的表現令人喜出望外。眾人鬥快「不用手穿褲子」，黃美棋使出瑜伽動作、周志康化身人肉四驅車，怪招盡出。出線比賽坐飛氈賽跑，何雁詩被對手大幅拋離，幸好最後一棒是美棋對連詩雅，賽果可想而知！

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 各實習飼養員結束了康養區和繁育園的學習和工作，回到神樹坪基地。這段時間，導師們見證了各實習生的成長過程，對他們的進步都感到滿意。另一方面，為了教育園區遊客關於熊貓的基礎知識，實習生們舉辦了教育課堂。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 繪萌、安娜、凜花的演唱會順利結束了，寶石偶像等待著四眼姐姐公佈接下來的順序。但是，表演順序還沒出爐，玫兒就已經站上舞台，還開始進行演唱會。在玫兒促使下，其他寶石偶像也相繼登上舞台。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 鑽石時裝大賽進入最高潮，尚未登台的寶石偶像只剩虹之咲、未來、杏樹三人。寶石時裝大賽開辦者虹之咲，奇蹟閃耀組的中心人物未來，還有星夢頻道偶像頂點的杏樹，鑽石偶像的寶座到底花落誰家!?

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄見家裡經濟財政緊絀，於是走去尋寶，多啦A夢知道後借他「尋寶機」和「飄浮噴霧」。大雄不小心害靜香的胸針掉進水塘，用過法寶「加醋減醋」後心生一計，但在前往水塘的路上遭遇諸多阻撓。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星團粵日
programme.desc: 在翼的努力之下，Ultras的工作漸上軌道，但A太卻因為一次誤會而抱怨翼把B-PROJECT放在優先，本身對Ultras頗有微詞的剛士因而與A太發生衝突，詎料此時公司卻下令要B-PROJECT發展YourTube，理想做法自然是請教精於此道的Ultras。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 發掘「魔都」隱世美食，來到地道麵館，婭溦、糖妹按照網上排名點菜，蛤蜊豬肝拌麵、茄盒、腰花辣肉湯麵，果真名不虛傳。光顧傳聞「怪脾氣」師傅蛋糕店、古早味冰糕與人氣脆香鮮肉月餅，風味小吃滋味連連。主持們被「古董花園」復古氛圍吸引，優雅地淺嚐美式鬆餅與造型蛋糕。接着遊逛老上海歐式風格小區，先打卡再覓食。入黑，味蕾試試新口味，主打越南粉的東南亞餐廳，可會是兩位主持杯茶？酒吧內的雞尾酒名字趣怪，越夜越精彩！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽提到羊肉有滋陰、補腎的功效，是進補的上佳食材。「印度羊肉飯」用上的印度米澱粉含量較低，而且纖維豐富，適合減肥人士。阿媽另將芫荽頭、黑胡椒、魚露等，加入免治羊肉中拌勻，再做成串燒，菜式同樣充滿異國風味。「孜然羊架」需要先煎後焗，但醃製步驟才是重點，有何獨門秘方？三道羊菜式均香濃惹味，肥媽特意準備清甜解膩的「菠蘿椰花糖雪花冰」作甜品。她帶6號到果欄選購菠蘿，泰國、台灣與菲律賓的品種究竟有甚麼分別？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 6號「單拖」到街市買海鮮，並發揮節目宗旨落力講價！他買來蛋白質豐富的鮑魚，讓肥媽炮製「薑蔥蠔油鮮鮑魚」。鮑魚裙邊呈現黑色，怎樣清潔？「酸菜魚」用上以魚頭與魚骨煮成的魚湯，鮮上加鮮；阿媽還提醒泡椒才是辣味來源，要小心用量。蒸蝦菜式以粉絲和勝瓜置底，能夠吸收蝦的鮮味。製作「涼拌小鮮魷」時，阿6竟拿自己與肥媽的身形教大家分辨魷魚和墨魚，當然惹得阿媽發火！另外，6號又會示範時下火熱飲品奶蓋茶的DIY做法。

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族群體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，了解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 振朗三人跟澳洲名勝三姐妹峰打卡，某人合照時笑言其美貌無死角！路旁駛來紅色跑車，只有兩名幸運兒可自駕遊車河，對講機的另一端則不斷傳來被拋下那一位的「葡萄」話語。眾主持於下午茶時間聊天，話題竟是圍繞內褲「亂噏」！到達豪華住宿地，朱仔躺進浴缸中不願起來。振朗隨後躺在其身上，還哼起歌來，果真有福同享？入夜，大家把酒談心。三人於劇集《反黑路人甲》建立友誼，談及這劇的拍攝點滴，振朗有一幕忍笑失敗仍被播出？

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 眾主持搭乘空中纜車睇靚景，期間更可登上車頂。振朗出發前曾許願要和慰玲拍MV，來到大型花園，節目組讓他化身「張導」，並爭分奪秒完成拍攝。MV用上「反黑」劇歌<對手戲，請細心觀賞箇中的「三角戀」演出。走進豪華遊艇來趟船屋體驗，主持們邊用餐邊訴說家人對各自演藝路的支持。三好友盛裝到海邊，原來是乘坐水上飛機，振朗更於空中與悉尼歌劇院打卡。在可欣賞海灘勝景的餐廳用膳，大家傾談結婚話題外，朱仔還會「劇透」！

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 吃甜品的口味，與個人形象、性格並無直接關係，甜品達人阿古(古嘉俊) 與嘉賓溫家偉(大隻仔)，雖然外形特質大不相同，卻原來大家同是英式下午茶的「擁躉」。有見及此，阿古特意準備了一款下午茶常見的鬆餅，並以新鮮水果製成大隻仔最愛的藍莓果醬，讓他安坐家中也能享用精美茶點。大隻仔就在製作甜品過程中發掘了不少竅門，足見他的細密心思。完成作品後，大隻仔亦會分享製作心得，以及透露心目中一種與下午茶最匹配的美食。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 天驚訝於太晴三人相識只有兩個月便能百無禁忌，太晴告訴他重點在於互相尊重的心。UNKNOWN出現，太晴三人陷入苦戰，天想通後重新坐上新幹線戰士，更憑著準確的觀察和指示，成功以戰術擊敗敵人。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「My Little Show」的才藝表演舞台再次展開，三位女孩伴隨節拍翩翩起舞，帶來可愛的芭蕾表演，洋溢童真魅力。另一位女生則以古箏彈奏桂林少數民族的舞曲，優雅琴音為現場增添古典氣息。隨着女結他導師彈奏<幼稚園、<告別校園時，她與主持姐姐放聲合唱，勾起許多美好的校園回憶，瀅仴姐姐尤其難忘有同學仔不小心在課堂上放屁的趣事。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 箭豬荒山在山上挖掘尋寶但一無所穫，後來遇到攤檔的蚯蚓媽媽，聽信其占卜並帶她上山。汪汪警察局接報蚯蚓媽媽被綁架，屁屁偵探亦獲邀加入調查，一行人根據種種線索，上山追查蚯蚓媽媽下落。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子家裡電視機故障，需要三天時間才能修好，小丸子自不用說，連姐姐也罕有地表示不滿。小玉正在看一本小說，並和冬田約好看完後互相分享感想，但過程中一直有事令她分心，導致閱讀進度緩慢。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 潛行天下粵
programme.desc: 《潛行天下》以全球海洋為主題，採用8K超高清攝影機和水下無人機等技術建構沉浸式觀影體驗，跨越四大洋14國水域拍攝，記錄雙髻鯊、鯨鯊等海洋生物活動，探密三沙永樂龍洞等特殊地形。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 戲棚在香港已有大約150年歷史，過往每逢神誕、太平清醮、盂蘭勝會，一座座臨時戲棚便會以竹、木搭建而成，棚內或做拜神儀式，或做「神功戲」表演。不過隨著城市發展及經濟轉型，不少拜神儀式已經簡化，部分社區在盂蘭勝會期間，更會轉用金屬取締竹木搭建的戲棚。面對行業式微，一群戲棚師傅如何延續傳統的竹棚技藝？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 旺角道行人天橋何故火光閃閃？原來這個外傭假日聚腳點仿如美食廣場，一個個紙皮箱之下隱約可見明火爐具，街坊擔心成安全隱患。節目搶先介紹四屆視后佘詩曼主演新劇《正義女神》；TVB全新營銷團隊才駿軒，為客戶提供度身訂造媒體服務，視帝陳豪、譚俊彥連同陳貝兒等星級代言人，推介服務詳情。運輸署「免試簽發」駕駛執照採用電子即日籌申領之後，依然一籌難求！記者與報料觀眾清晨上網，實測輪籌難度；非即日的預約情況又如何？

programme.title: 香港歐化飛鷹活絡油呈獻:中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 導師分組賽迎來最終回，台上再次舉行獨唱較量，三隊代表分別演繹那英、張學友、張惠妹的作品。這集最低分隊伍要淘汰一人之外，本輪三集累積總分最低隊伍亦會有兩人被淘汰，競爭越趨白熱化！紅隊布志綸、紫隊高少華、綠隊張嘉銘，三位導師各自帶領的學員當中，誰人即將離開《中4》舞台？此外，這集亦會誕生本輯節目的首位MVP。

programme.title: 一周星星粵
programme.desc: 黎耀祥、蕭正楠、曹永廉因參演《大太監》而熟絡，早前拍綜藝自駕遊澳洲，有何深刻點滴？除了啜核挖苦的日常外，他們亦會有浪漫一面！「你問我答」，黎諾懿向祥哥索「拎視帝」秘訣，祥哥亦妙趣示範相同對白的三種演繹。阿蕭又可「恨得獎」？阿廉的腰圍受黃智賢關注，主持潘盈慧拿出量尺……某人錄音控訴阿蕭常與阿廉通電話，又不時穿著對方衣服，莫非有不可告人之事？三位好丈夫又會如何回答「我今日有何不同」這條經典的女伴提問？

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 星廚莫燦霖推介居酒屋，與波波享用炒墨魚配木魚醬油汁、高森和牛三文治配牛骨湯，令人回味無窮。北角地膽施焯日走訪該區的食街，試吃吞拿魚蘋果碎蛋比高包、不同餡料的煎餃，以及台式麻醬涼麵配滷水百頁豆腐。Agnes再帶焯日品嚐新派韓式風味亞洲料理，包括配上水果特製醬汁的魷魚刺身、咖喱韓式炸雞，以及紹酒醉醬油蟹，盡是不一樣的味道。九龍城開業逾七十年的清真菜館，其爆汁牛肉餅、羊肉小籠包與咖喱羊腩，皆為必試名物。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 叠影狙擊#8粵PG
programme.desc: 曉晨潛入文諾的辦公室放下竊聽器，怎料被監控鏡頭拍下來了，於是將錯就錯，假裝投靠文諾，並藉著人工島的計劃書，取得俊雄的信任。恆輝無故失蹤，天齊懷疑院長謀財害命，於是潛入院長室，竟然發現大量老人的身份證…

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 旺角道行人天橋何故火光閃閃？原來這個外傭假日聚腳點仿如美食廣場，一個個紙皮箱之下隱約可見明火爐具，街坊擔心成安全隱患。節目搶先介紹四屆視后佘詩曼主演新劇《正義女神》；TVB全新營銷團隊才駿軒，為客戶提供度身訂造媒體服務，視帝陳豪、譚俊彥連同陳貝兒等星級代言人，推介服務詳情。運輸署「免試簽發」駕駛執照採用電子即日籌申領之後，依然一籌難求！記者與報料觀眾清晨上網，實測輪籌難度；非即日的預約情況又如何？

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族群體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，了解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 四人到清邁郊外等待看日出，並訴說相關經歷。和嘉洛同往看日出許願竟是兩男？JW最有記憶的日出，是與吳業坤一起拍劇。畏高的JW鼓起勇氣試玩動力滑翔傘，降落即要求擁抱互勉。登艇遊河兼食船麵，甚麼令陳瀅眼濕濕？走進市場，大家開始試吃之行，JW獻出食榴槤第一次。主持們換上民族服，邊品嚐地道美食邊欣賞民族表演。四人分組在周末市集買食物開餐，同時考驗另類默契。挑戰叢林間的過山車與飛索，JW能否再次戰勝恐懼？

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 深入清邁鄉村逛小店，朱仔竟踴躍發言，拍檔都配合地轉為「靜音模式」。朱仔更挑戰JW底線要其吃蜜蜂蛋，嚇得她落荒而逃！四人分享清邁之旅難忘點滴，有人講到喊，更發覺此行絕對不容嘉洛缺席！大家還透過收到的禮物，競猜自己的「秘密天使」……張振朗、賴慰玲接力出發，辦理飛澳洲的登機手續之際，朱仔驚喜送機，卻是「計中計」，他會乘坐航班的商務位同行。站在海水中央食蠔，可有特別感受？不過，振朗的熟練開蠔技術才是焦點！

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 吃甜品的口味，與個人形象、性格並無直接關係，甜品達人阿古(古嘉俊) 與嘉賓溫家偉(大隻仔)，雖然外形特質大不相同，卻原來大家同是英式下午茶的「擁躉」。有見及此，阿古特意準備了一款下午茶常見的鬆餅，並以新鮮水果製成大隻仔最愛的藍莓果醬，讓他安坐家中也能享用精美茶點。大隻仔就在製作甜品過程中發掘了不少竅門，足見他的細密心思。完成作品後，大隻仔亦會分享製作心得，以及透露心目中一種與下午茶最匹配的美食。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 糖妹、婭溦變身優雅吃貨，置身以老香港美學打造的點心餐廳，品嚐燉老鴿湯、波龍蘆筍餃、Q彈太雕蛋蒸黃魚，黑米鹹水角又有甚麼驚喜滋味？兩位可人兒轉往別緻Cafe，一件拿破崙草莓蛋糕，她們竟掀起吉士醬與奶油之爭！分途發掘魔都小店，糖妹踏足潮人必到的中古風生活雜貨，搜羅各式可愛造型的創意家品。另一邊廂，婭溦在澳洲網紅旗艦店朝聖，「悉瓜」蛋糕一試難忘。放慢腳步，二人偷得浮生光顧酒館，糖妹還會挑戰辣辣上海川菜！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽提到羊肉有滋陰、補腎的功效，是進補的上佳食材。「印度羊肉飯」用上的印度米澱粉含量較低，而且纖維豐富，適合減肥人士。阿媽另將芫荽頭、黑胡椒、魚露等，加入免治羊肉中拌勻，再做成串燒，菜式同樣充滿異國風味。「孜然羊架」需要先煎後焗，但醃製步驟才是重點，有何獨門秘方？三道羊菜式均香濃惹味，肥媽特意準備清甜解膩的「菠蘿椰花糖雪花冰」作甜品。她帶6號到果欄選購菠蘿，泰國、台灣與菲律賓的品種究竟有甚麼分別？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 6號「單拖」到街市買海鮮，並發揮節目宗旨落力講價！他買來蛋白質豐富的鮑魚，讓肥媽炮製「薑蔥蠔油鮮鮑魚」。鮑魚裙邊呈現黑色，怎樣清潔？「酸菜魚」用上以魚頭與魚骨煮成的魚湯，鮮上加鮮；阿媽還提醒泡椒才是辣味來源，要小心用量。蒸蝦菜式以粉絲和勝瓜置底，能夠吸收蝦的鮮味。製作「涼拌小鮮魷」時，阿6竟拿自己與肥媽的身形教大家分辨魷魚和墨魚，當然惹得阿媽發火！另外，6號又會示範時下火熱飲品奶蓋茶的DIY做法。

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 各實習飼養員結束了康養區和繁育園的學習和工作，回到神樹坪基地。這段時間，導師們見證了各實習生的成長過程，對他們的進步都感到滿意。另一方面，為了教育園區遊客關於熊貓的基礎知識，實習生們舉辦了教育課堂。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#55粵
programme.desc: 有少女擁躉向朋表白。朋嚴詞拒絕，但少女對他死纏難打，悅擺出愛理不理的樣子。溢提議製造出「外遇煙幕」，朋假意要和外遇度春宵，令家人也感非教訓有朋不可，終成功揭發整件事，有朋夫婦又再甜蜜地走在一起。

programme.title: 天龍八部#28粵普PG
programme.desc: 玄慈命戒律院對虛竹行杖刑，葉二娘看到虛竹露出九個戒點香疤，認出他就是自己的孩兒，而玄慈承認自己就是虛竹的父親，群僧和眾人嘩然；玄慈指責慕容博假傳消息，目的就是為挑起宋遼紛爭，慕容氏就可以趁機復興燕國…

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 阿譚引領鼎爺前往搜羅上海菜食材，烤麩正是其中所愛。烹調「上海烤麩」，還會用上金針，鼎爺期間向阿譚講述二者的起源故事。鼎爺竟不施展刀功，反而用手將烤麩撕碎？烤麩要待涼才可享用，鼎爺把握時間帶來非一般的「家常菜飯」，還出動豬油為菜飯的味道昇華。二人再到老字號麵廠，參觀雲吞皮的製作過程。只包上海雲吞，豈能滿足阿譚的口胃，鼎爺加碼炮製「砂鍋雲吞雞」。主持們提醒用白菜做餡料要先焯煮榨乾，否則雲吞皮容易弄穿！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 冬春季交替期間特別多花粉散播，容易誘發敏感性哮喘，要診斷出可有患上哮喘，醫學院內科學系學者提到需完成幾項檢查。哮喘當前的一線治療是甚麼？又是如何判別病人是否適合採用生物製劑？抗癌勇士吳文忻這集細談好友為她而辦的「在世追思會」，笑言似加油式聚會，也換來一覺好睡！患病讓文忻感受到不同的愛，她建議大家善待自己，並注重身體、心靈健康。「睇餸食飯」，三姐將過年吃剩的年糕配以韓國白年糕，炮製「脆皮鴛鴦年糕」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在東莞粵
programme.desc: 本集開啟尋找東莞高埗鎮特色美食之旅，祖藍引領大家於一天內品嚐兩道「非遺」食品。第一道當然是高埗最出名的水鄉菜系美食— 冼沙魚丸，另一道則是保安圍扣肉，看似普通的魚丸與扣肉，製作起來一點都不簡單，祖藍還會親自落場試做一番。此外，高埗鎮內還藏着一家不起眼的糖水舖，食品於開業廿多年來近乎沒有加價，就是其招牌……

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#7粵PG
programme.desc: 兆明知道自己給兆賢太大壓力，曉盈擁抱他安慰時，卻剛好被司徒嵐看見。兆明不慎令秀瓊受傷送院；秀瓊命司徒嵐與兆明分手，更掌摑了她。兆明向司徒嵐解釋為何不接電話，司徒嵐覺得不能為他分憂，決定分手。秀瓊率領全體員工拜神，徵求德正同意恢復舊制度，更提議辭退兆明。秀瓊乘機提醒竇彰，勸他繼續追求司徒嵐。兆賢拒見兆明，兆明破門而入。兆明坦言為了供兆賢讀書受盡委屈，但仍原意繼續供讀書。兆明復工，全體員工愕然……

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: IDOLiSH7、TRIGGER和Re:vale獲邀成為重頭慈善節目「Friends Day」的主持，而先導環節係三個團體突然被安排前往熱海集訓，並需要在24小時內為節目創作主題曲，但這群我行我素的偶像讓各自的經紀人提心吊膽。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「廠長話」遊戲，兩隊各有一人率先出局，剩下的隊友為獲得零食秘笈獎勵奮戰。然而「廠長話」跳兩下時，有人竟沒反應……稍後執行神奇地壺任務，雙方表現各異。某隊經過五次嘗試才「拿下」首個奇幻食材，另一隊則有成員連番一擊即中。踏入看圖砌漢堡關卡，首回合中，兩隊均曾放錯食材順序，需要花時間調整。在接下來的兩回合比拼，小兵們要更加專注，避免再次拿錯而延誤完成時間。「AI小學堂」，嘉賓分享可怎樣在學習上善用AI。

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 小丸原本想應徵的兼職，被二年級前輩搶先受聘了。斜堂老師被校醫勸說，為了健康，必須多些在陽光下做運動。亂太郎連續兩晚的夢都應驗了。第三晚，亂太郎夢到測驗取得100分。亂太郎對此充滿期待。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 多發性骨髓瘤是體內漿細胞癌變的血液惡性腫瘤，一般好發於60至70歲以上的年長者。主要症狀包括高血鈣、腎功能不全、貧血、骨頭病變（骨痛或骨折）。由於該病容易復發，目前仍然是難以完全治癒的慢性病，但有包括標靶、免疫調節劑，以及幹細胞移植治療，可大幅延長存活期。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2765粵
programme.desc: 尚善通宵趕工撰寫計劃書，搶先於力蓮呈交，也獲敢威通過。力蓮不忿之餘，更得知敢威似對她心存不滿，還有意「傳位」予尚善。為求爭取更佳表現，力蓮遂通宵撰寫另一項目的計劃書，成功與合作方簽約後，又繼續馬不停蹄地處理其他事務。其後，力蓮獲俊華告知由他自創的特別休息方法，只需利用極短時間，便能「叉電」回復精神。力蓮照辦，初時成效顯著，但漸漸卻出現問題，甚至難以入眠。為求成功入睡，她作出了不少嘗試……

programme.title: X Wallet呈獻:臥底嬌娃#17粵
programme.desc: 小茹成功登入嘉盈的電腦，發現電腦疑被掉包，佳琪懷疑是奕風所為。另邊廂，妙姿發現劉彪的秘密。佳琪發現邦妮似乎早已知悉劉彪出軌。佳琪偷偷在奕風的嫲嫲家中安裝監視裝置，果然發現是奕風偷走嘉盈的電腦，卻於監控內見到奕風情緒有異。小茹一直在撮合歐凱和寶儀，歐凱終忍不住向小茹說出他有喜歡的人。佳琪的父親沈逸良心臟病發，她及後還得知自己遺忘了的一段記憶。小茹探望索帕，驚悉對方原來就是臥底小組一直調查的目標人物。

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#9粵普PG
programme.desc: 瑾瑜請畫眉賜教之際傳來驚呼聲，竟是沁香落水身亡。楚楚發現沁香身上有可疑痕跡，想解剖屍體，瑾瑜雖擔心她會染上疳霉瘡，但仍批准並叮囑她小心。沁香兄嫂到教坊鬧事，瑾瑜向畫眉詢問情況，再與楚楚去沁香房間查看。

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：他們的澳洲駕期粵
programme.desc: 繼續雪山玩樂之行，三兄弟體驗滑雪，單是學習單腳滑行已甚疲累？祥哥、阿蕭升呢挑戰初階雪道，阿廉卻耍手擰頭……轉玩老少咸宜的雪兜，阿廉又被作弄，「炒車」收場！速度大激鬥，輸家要替老友「揸兜」？談到自駕遊經驗，阿蕭難忘與太太黃翠如往海外註冊的趣事。漫步吉朗的海濱步道，觸發「尋找指定彩繪木偶」任務，阿蕭還將木偶當成愛妻？沿大洋路海岸線行駛，三人買朱古力手信、在紀念拱門打卡，再登高細訴事業與家庭的高光時刻。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#25粵
programme.desc: 少龍求秦王下旨搜查呂府。少龍在花園發現趙倩的衣服破布及娘蓉送給她的小兔，又找出八人在案發時沒有不在場證據，包括嫪毐及娘蓉。少龍在馬車上發現趙倩的珠釵，激動地欲殺車伕。少龍推辭出任廷尉，朱姬乘機再推薦嫪毐。朱姬要秦王陪她到驪山浸溫泉，秦王建議由嬴政陪她。嫪毐與朱姬牽手往浸溫泉，成蟜母秀麗夫人向秦王告密，秦王去捉姦卻見池中只有朱姬一人，將秀麗打入冷宮，朱姬暗喜。少龍在趙倩墓前拜祭，離開時赫見琴清出現。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.desc: 冬春季交替期間特別多花粉散播，容易誘發敏感性哮喘，要診斷出可有患上哮喘，醫學院內科學系學者提到需完成幾項檢查。哮喘當前的一線治療是甚麼？又是如何判別病人是否適合採用生物製劑？抗癌勇士吳文忻這集細談好友為她而辦的「在世追思會」，笑言似加油式聚會，也換來一覺好睡！患病讓文忻感受到不同的愛，她建議大家善待自己，並注重身體、心靈健康。「睇餸食飯」，三姐將過年吃剩的年糕配以韓國白年糕，炮製「脆皮鴛鴦年糕」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在東莞粵
programme.desc: 本集開啟尋找東莞高埗鎮特色美食之旅，祖藍引領大家於一天內品嚐兩道「非遺」食品。第一道當然是高埗最出名的水鄉菜系美食— 冼沙魚丸，另一道則是保安圍扣肉，看似普通的魚丸與扣肉，製作起來一點都不簡單，祖藍還會親自落場試做一番。此外，高埗鎮內還藏着一家不起眼的糖水舖，食品於開業廿多年來近乎沒有加價，就是其招牌……

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#7粵PG
programme.desc: 兆明知道自己給兆賢太大壓力，曉盈擁抱他安慰時，卻剛好被司徒嵐看見。兆明不慎令秀瓊受傷送院；秀瓊命司徒嵐與兆明分手，更掌摑了她。兆明向司徒嵐解釋為何不接電話，司徒嵐覺得不能為他分憂，決定分手。秀瓊率領全體員工拜神，徵求德正同意恢復舊制度，更提議辭退兆明。秀瓊乘機提醒竇彰，勸他繼續追求司徒嵐。兆賢拒見兆明，兆明破門而入。兆明坦言為了供兆賢讀書受盡委屈，但仍原意繼續供讀書。兆明復工，全體員工愕然……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#55粵
programme.desc: 有少女擁躉向朋表白。朋嚴詞拒絕，但少女對他死纏難打，悅擺出愛理不理的樣子。溢提議製造出「外遇煙幕」，朋假意要和外遇度春宵，令家人也感非教訓有朋不可，終成功揭發整件事，有朋夫婦又再甜蜜地走在一起。

programme.title: 天龍八部#28粵普PG
programme.desc: 玄慈命戒律院對虛竹行杖刑，葉二娘看到虛竹露出九個戒點香疤，認出他就是自己的孩兒，而玄慈承認自己就是虛竹的父親，群僧和眾人嘩然；玄慈指責慕容博假傳消息，目的就是為挑起宋遼紛爭，慕容氏就可以趁機復興燕國…

programme.title: 我係小廚神粵
programme.desc: 由林盛斌、黃翠如主持的烹飪比賽節目《我係小廚神》，經過麥潔兒、古嘉俊、韋兆嫻、劉晉、黎志安及楊國基六位專業評審費盡心力挑選，有30位小廚神進入節目競賽。他們先接受自選菜式比試，爭奪12個晉級名額。

programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的岩漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 檢索愛情
programme.desc: 【林秀晶X張基龍大談姐弟戀年下男狂撩職場女強人】聚焦於三位35歲女性——裴朵美、車賢和宋佳景，她們在職場和感情中勇敢追夢。這三位獨立的女性，專注於自己的事業，成為職場上的佼佼者。然而在她們堅強的外表下，深藏著對愛情的渴望。儘管在追求夢想的道路上充滿坎坷，她們依然堅信自己的抉擇。在她們身後都有一位，用自己的方式默默守護的真命天子，以現實的筆觸描繪了這三個女性在職場上的競爭和情感中的糾結，將粉紅泡泡與現實的辛酸完美結合。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與朴海鎮領銜，知名主角群展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神秘性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 韓國小姐(完)
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S3
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的岩漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 檢索愛情
programme.desc: 【林秀晶X張基龍大談姐弟戀年下男狂撩職場女強人】聚焦於三位35歲女性——裴朵美、車賢和宋佳景，她們在職場和感情中勇敢追夢。這三位獨立的女性，專注於自己的事業，成為職場上的佼佼者。然而在她們堅強的外表下，深藏著對愛情的渴望。儘管在追求夢想的道路上充滿坎坷，她們依然堅信自己的抉擇。在她們身後都有一位，用自己的方式默默守護的真命天子，以現實的筆觸描繪了這三個女性在職場上的競爭和情感中的糾結，將粉紅泡泡與現實的辛酸完美結合。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與朴海鎮領銜，知名主角群展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神秘性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與朴海鎮領銜，知名主角群展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神秘性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 檢索愛情
programme.desc: 【林秀晶X張基龍大談姐弟戀年下男狂撩職場女強人】聚焦於三位35歲女性——裴朵美、車賢和宋佳景，她們在職場和感情中勇敢追夢。這三位獨立的女性，專注於自己的事業，成為職場上的佼佼者。然而在她們堅強的外表下，深藏著對愛情的渴望。儘管在追求夢想的道路上充滿坎坷，她們依然堅信自己的抉擇。在她們身後都有一位，用自己的方式默默守護的真命天子，以現實的筆觸描繪了這三個女性在職場上的競爭和情感中的糾結，將粉紅泡泡與現實的辛酸完美結合。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Consideration - EP122
programme.desc: In this episode we will understand that prudence is related to common sense and caution, to think about what you are going to say and when you can say it. Discretion is to behave in a way that does not offend anyone or reveal information. If you want to be discreet, you have to act with caution! You should think first of the consequences of your actions in order to make the best decisions.

programme.desc: The gang helps Patty with an eco-friendly spooky costume party; Preston's genetically modified crops are going crazy.

programme.desc: Kent discovers one of Edison’s secret inventions – an exo-bodysuit: a steampunk Ironman device that turns him into a klutzy superhero. Ever-confident Nicky finds herself competing with Sheila in a “Project Runway”-type show, and, needing the perfect model to show off her designs on the runway, she decides to clone herself.

programme.title: Secret Millionaires Club - A Midwestern Yankee In King Arthur's Court, Pt. 3 - EP114
programme.desc: The SMC kids race to find the final Two Golden Rules, save Guinevere and recover the Book of Spells in time to return home.

programme.desc: Arnold Armstrong, formerly the superhero Captain Fantastic, faces an unexpected career change after losing his superpowers in a final epic showdown with Dr. Superior; he’s now tasked with guiding a special group of 6 kids through superhero training and the challenges of kindergarten.

programme.title: Argo's World
programme.desc: Join Marie and Argo in this exciting STEM edutainment mixed-media series as they venture through Cyberspace and make discoveries about the world through historical figures and notable real-world personalities! Special guests include a founding father of the Internet, a NASA astronaut, a top robotics expert, and clever folks from M.I.T!

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: The Fixies
programme.desc: The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment. There’s just no end to the troubles Tom Thomas and his Fixie friends get themselves into with all the gadgets and appliances around them!

programme.title: Gods Gang - Gods Gang - God's Gang | Terror Tubes Takedown | Episode 7
programme.desc: The Gang dives headfirst into the Fear Zone - and it’s pure chaos. With Nightmare Mode activated and the Fear Bomb ticking, only faith can light the way.

programme.title: Gods Gang - Gods Gang - God's Gang | The Breath of Courage | Episode 8
programme.desc: With 60 seconds left, the Fear Bomb ticks toward doom. Kungfuda and God's Gang fight with faith and love - will light prevail or fear win?

programme.title: Gods Gang - Gods Gang - God's Gang | Alien Mayhem! | Episode 1, 2, 3
programme.desc: God’s Gang faces insane challenges - from stopping a mad scientist to battling aliens and saving blue whales.

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyson the Tanker refuels Jeremy
programme.desc: Oh no, Jeremy ran out of gas! Troy selects the most perfect truck to refuel him: Tyson the Tanker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Francis the Forklift helps at the construction site
programme.desc: Edgar made a mess at the construction site! Troy selects the best truck to help with the clean-up: Francis the Forklift!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyler the Tyke steals candy
programme.desc: Tyler stole some candy from Baby Francis! Troy selects the bravest, fastest car to stop him: Matt the Police Car!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Chuck the Cherry Picker saves the day!
programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Carl the Super Truck helps Frank the Firetruck
programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The castle of Robins
programme.desc: Since the lens fails to be recovered, Dr. No wants to make another, but he needs robins to make it. So he attacks Rubidia, a region filled with different precious stones. But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. But the boy gets the scientist falls into a trap and also helps free the slaves of Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The harmonica trap
programme.desc: Chip and his friends create a zone with formations resembling musical instruments and make sounds harmonious. Suddenly, they become trapped within a rectangle of quartz crystals that vibrate when they form a sonic trap. A musician atom who has caught them, seeks members to assemble an orchestra. The antimatters are near and Chip asked the musician to prepare the trap to retain them and escape. The musician agrees and the antimatters are prisoners of the musician that makes them hear the terrible sound of his compositions.

programme.desc: Katy needs help; she's feeling sick! Troy selects the most helpful, kindest car he knows: Amber the Ambulance!

programme.desc: Suzy had an accident and needs urgent help! Troy selects the most perfect vehicle to help rescue her: Hector the Helicopter!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Sam the Snowplough clears the streets
programme.desc: Lilly and Tom are stuck in the snow! Troy selects the most perfect truck for the job: Sam the Snowplough!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL &amp; WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The rare earth
programme.desc: Along the way, Chip and his friends find an island surrounded by a large lake of acid, under the constant threat of eruption of a volcano. In the island lives lanthanide atoms, according to the legend, are awaiting the arrival of a "chosen" to give them acid that prevents them from leaving the island. Chip, thanks to his book, discovers that the volcano emitted a base when mixed with the acid may neutralize and make the dangerous lake in a nice extension of salt water.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The desert
programme.desc: Across a hot desert Chip and the atoms found themselves with a tungsten atom that gives them refuge under a pyramid-shaped building that, until recently, had an ingenious cooling system through which flowed a stream of ammonia in its basement. But now, Dr. No has diverted the flow of ammonia for his own benefit. Chip discovers the point where ammonia diverts and builds a dam that returns to its normal course.

programme.title: Helen Dorn: The Right To Remain Silent
programme.desc: During a hunting trip, Rolf Kanther, director of a military tech manufacturer, is shot right next to his daughter. Inspector Helen Dorn is sent to investigate the suspicious death, and needs to find out if it's an accident or a calculated murder.

programme.title: Oddball
programme.desc: An eccentric chicken farmer, with the help of his granddaughter, trains his mischievous dog Oddball to protect a penguin sanctuary from fox attacks in an attempt to reunite his family and save their seaside town.

programme.title: Cortina Express
programme.desc: During the Christmas holidays in Cortina, a colorful cast of characters cross paths among the snow-capped Ampezzo mountains. Between love, redemption, and second-chances, their lives collide in a series of hilarious and heartfelt quests for a happy ending

programme.title: Sarah Kohr: Ghost Lights
programme.desc: In a post-pandemic Europe, conspiracy theorist Felix Morgenroth becomes obsessed with exposing the "coronavirus lie." Convinced that physicians Carsten and Lisa Kippmann were behind the conspiracy, Felix seeks retribution through a devastating explosion.

programme.title: Stormskerry Maja
programme.desc: At 17, Maja marries humble fisherman Janne and starts a family on the remote island of Stormskerry, where survival is a constant challenge. Amidst the hardships, Maja awakens to her potential, finding resilience and a love that transcends life and death.

programme.title: Hippocrates
programme.desc: Benjamin dreams of being a great doctor, but his internship at his father’s ward doesn’t turn out the way he hoped. His experience as a junior doctor, with its overwhelming responsibility and stiff competition, forces him to confront his limits and fears.

programme.title: Moon's Walking
programme.desc: On the day of her grandmother’s memorial, 16-year-old Jung-hee escapes a volatile home and goes on a journey in search for the truth behind her grandfather’s disappearance.

programme.title: Until Tomorrow
programme.desc: A single mother's courage is tested when she resorts to desperate measures to hide her illegitimate child from her parents.

programme.title: Sweet Squad
programme.desc: In Kalimantan Barat, teenager Rizal faces a daunting choice to become a sugar courier across the Indonesian-Malaysian border to fund his mother's medical bills. With friends Iwan and Ajung, they risk it all for a chance at saving his mother’s life.

programme.title: Carte Blanche
programme.desc: An uplifting tale of Kacper, a charismatic high school history teacher who hides his progressing blindness from everyone around him to fulfil his educational duties. His methods are unorthodox, sometimes hilarious, and devilishly effective.

programme.title: Helen Dorn: The Right To Remain Silent
programme.desc: During a hunting trip, Rolf Kanther, director of a military tech manufacturer, is shot right next to his daughter. Inspector Helen Dorn is sent to investigate the suspicious death, and needs to find out if it's an accident or a calculated murder.

programme.title: All The Songs We Never Sang
programme.desc: Rebellious teen Natsumi ventures from Tokyo to a small island to meet her aunt and learn the art of pearl diving (but secretly to find a treasure she was told about as a child).

programme.title: The Voice
programme.desc: To be released from a terrifying voice, Derya must do as it says and follow the one man closest to her, Onur - her boss and childhood friend. Soon enough Derya uncovers some shocking truths about him and is caught up in a dangerous web.

programme.title: Heavenly Nomadic
programme.desc: A family of nomads dwelling high in the mountains of Kyrgyzstan doesn't need any of the conveniences of modern civilization in order to be happy. But progress is creeping into their lives regardless, destroying legends and traditions as it comes.

programme.title: Confession
programme.desc: Laras was pressured to express his decision to live without children when his in-laws asked him to adopt a child because he was deemed unable to produce offspring.

programme.title: Sweet Dreams

programme.title: Azam and Johan - EP12
programme.desc: Azam & Johan bercita-cita menjadi pemain bola sepak profesional. Kemalangan menyebabkan Azam lumpuh, memusnahkan impian bola sepaknya. Ibu mereka menyalahkan Johan atas kemalangan itu.

programme.title: Lelaki Macam Dia - EP6
programme.desc: Fahmi dan Husna merupakan jiran yang tinggal bersebelahan rumah. Fahmi seorang yang lurus dan tidak mempunyai perwatakan yang menarik akhirnya mampu berubah menjadi seorang "superstar" dan memikat hati Hus

programme.title: Sesat - EP11
programme.desc: Sesat, rancangan yang menguji minda dan ikhtiar hidup selebriti tempatan dalam mencari destinasi yang ditetapkan.

programme.title: Diari Mangkuk Tingkat Bersama Ili - EP7
programme.desc: Bersama Ili menyediakan hidangan yang menyelerakan untuk selebriti terkenal tanah air dalam Diari Mangkuk Tingkat.

programme.title: Hard To Heart - EP2
programme.desc: Program temubual bersama artis tersohor, mengenai jatuh bangun mereka dalam sepanjang terbabit dengan kerjaya seni tempatan.

programme.title: In Love with Tya - EP7
programme.desc: In Love with Tya adalah program realiti yang memaparkan perjalanan hidup Tya untuk merealisasikan impiannya dan bagaimana Tya berjaya mengatasi masalah dalam kehidupan seharian.

programme.title: Jalan Kembali: Bohsia 2
programme.desc: Empat sekawan cuba mematahkan rancangan seorang lelaki yang cuba merosakkan gadis-gadis jalanan dengan membawa mereka ke jalan yang haram.

programme.title: Halal Maps - EP13
programme.desc: Menampilkan sajian kulinari seluruh dunia, Halal Maps menemui penduduk tempatan yang berkongsi hidangan Halal kegemaran di bandar mereka, di mana mendapatkannya dan bagaimana menuju ke sana.

programme.title: Siapa Jaga Mak? - EP3
programme.desc: Diilhamkan oleh kisah-kisah pengasuh yang benar, Siapa Jaga Mak ceritakan tentang empat keluarga yang menghadapi pelbagai emosi daripada penjagaan orang tua.

programme.title: Survival 486
programme.desc: Syuhada pergi mendaki ke Gunung Tahan bersama kawan-kawannya. Malangnya, dia tersesat dan jatuh ke dalam lubang yang dalam dan terperangkap di sana selama 19 hari.

programme.title: Pernikahan Palsu - EP5
programme.desc: Sehari sebelum hari perkahwinannya dengan Aji, Nila mengalami kemalangan dan hilang penglihatan. Aji membatalkan perkahwinan itu. Galang yang tidak sanggup melihat Nila, terdesak untuk melamar Nila.

programme.title: Harta Dalam Stor - EP5
programme.desc: Ikuti hos Nabil Mahir dan Azhar Sulaiman menerjah stor kediaman selebriti tanahair untuk mencari barang-barang yang boleh digunapakai dan dijual.

programme.title: Kak Kek Ke Kelate - EP6
programme.desc: Kak Kek, alter ego Catriona Ross akan menjelajah ke Kelantan untuk mencari makanan viral di Kelantan di samping membawa penonton meneroka keunikan dan tempat menarik yang ada.

programme.title: Casa Liburan - EP2
programme.desc: Pengacara akan membawa penonton meneroka rumah-rumah mewah yang unik dan menarik milik hartawan di Malaysia.

programme.title: Curi-Curi Cuti - EP12
programme.desc: Saksikan Kamal Adli sebagai hos membawa selebriti bercuti bersama peminatnya dalam Curi-Curi Cuti di bawah kempen #expeRIAnce.

programme.title: Bukan Cinta Sempurna - EP10
programme.desc: Diana berterima kasih kepada Qistina kerana kehadirannya telah membuat Luqman semakin bahagia. Akibat berlaku salah faham, kekecohan berlaku antara Hadi dan Benjamin.

programme.title: Juara Joran - EP14
programme.desc: Rancangan realiti yang melibatkan seorang pemancing dan seorang artis dalam satu pasukan. Mereka akan bersaing melalui cabaran ketahanan fizikal, mental, bakat memancing dan memasak.

programme.title: My Buskers - EP7
programme.desc: Rancangan yang mempersembahkan selebriti-selebriti tempatan menyanyi bersama-sama dengan buskers-buskers tempatan menyanyikan lagu-lagu popular.

programme.title: Check In : Cinta - EP1

programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Stuck
programme.desc: All of the Teletubbies are stuck. Tinky Winky's hand is stuck in the bag, Dipsy's hat is stuck, Laa-Laa's ball is stuck and Po is stuck on the Tubby Slidey!

programme.title: Teletubbies Ready Steady Go! (S1) - I Can Be Anything
programme.desc: Join the dance party with the Teletubbies! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po dance and sing and follow their dreams.

programme.title: Pop Paper City (S1) - The Friendship Parade
programme.desc: Plom, Phoebe, Mae-Mae, Hooper, Zip, and Fly are a group of unique paper friends who live in Pop Paper City. They find new ways to have fun, such as playing pirates, building theme parks and even exploring outer space.

programme.title: Dog Loves Books (S1) - Dog Loves Art
programme.desc: Pug wants to learn how to paint. Our heroes visit Picasso's studio in Paris.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Thirsty Robot
programme.desc: Messy monster can't work out why his cart won't move. The wheels just won't go round like normal. Off he goes to OKIDO to find out why.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Mr Kite Takes Flight
programme.desc: Messy, a monster, explores science questions that children ask about the world around us. Messy monster is just about to take a bite out of his delicious green sock for breakfast, but before he can it gets blown away! He goes to OKIDO to find out why the wind is so blowy.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - UFO
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo only wanted to help fix a satellite dish with Mojo's chopper top. Now they've been mistaken for a UFO, and the whole town is in a tizzy about invading aliens!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S1) - It's time to bake
programme.desc: Gran Gran and JoJo are excited to bake a batch of Great Gran Gran's signature Saint Lucian banana bread, but there's a problem - they don't know how long to bake it for!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S1) - It's time to find a butterfly
programme.desc: JoJo searches for a butterfly to complete her nature tick-book. She learns that all butterflies start life as furry little caterpillars.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Old Toys
programme.desc: Duck is bored of his toy collection, so he and Sarah search for old toys in the attic.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Hair Cut
programme.desc: Sarah's hair keeps getting in her way, so it's time for a trip to the hairdressers.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - Nia's Bright Idea
programme.desc: Nia uses what she learns about lighthouses to suggest covering a big wheel in Christmas lights, so that Harold can see where he's going in a storm.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Bob Bilby
programme.desc: When it's Bingo's turn to bring her Kindy's Bob Bilby puppet home and record their weekend in the scrapbook, the family resolve to show him a good time.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Spy Game
programme.desc: When Bingo stops playing Bluey's spy game, their grown-up controlling device stops working properly! Bluey now sees how important Bingo is and needs to win her back!

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Takeaway
programme.desc: Forced to wait five minutes in front of a restaurant for their takeaway, Bluey and Bingo become restless for entertainment, pushing the very limits of Dad's patience.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Veggie Magic
programme.desc: When Evil Pea poses as a magician so that she can use tricks to make the Tato Team 'disappear', Supertato and Carrot create their own magical plan to rescue them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Biology Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels hop inside the Biology Bus and miniaturize themselves.

programme.desc: Happy sets his sights on a questionable looking puddle that he is determined to splash in!

programme.desc: Glitch gets into a mountain of trouble as the Go Jetters attempt to climb the Matterhorn.

programme.desc: Xuli and Glitch go head to head as they try to beat the Go Jet Academy land speed record.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Rainforests of Sumatra, Indonesia
programme.desc: Can the Go Jetters save the world's stinkiest plant from becoming Glitch's latest perfume?

programme.desc: Orson is cooking his special version of Bakewell tart. To make things more exciting, he is throwing his friends an afternoon tea party with fancy dress. This is going to be fun!

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Baby Dusky Leaf Monkey
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to Malaysia, South East Asia on a baby animal mission to find out why new born dusky leaf monkeys look so different to their parents.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S8) - Boom Family Reunion
programme.desc: In this episode Seaweed is missing his family, so Sandy organises a 'Boom' video call with his (and Captain Captain's) unusual relatives.

programme.title: Panda and Krash (S1) - Krash's New Friend
programme.desc: A beam of light sweeps through the window. Krash finds a glowing ball bouncing in the shop

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Shaun

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Daddy Putdown

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Dance Mode

programme.desc: Evil Pea plans to freeze Supertato into an ice cube by pretending to teach him to dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Say Hello

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S2) - Goat

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S3) - Chattering Teeth

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Got Your Goat
programme.desc: Mojo Swoptops and best buddy Bo love to help their friends in the little town of Swoppiton. With a swop of Mojo's top and Bo's brilliant plans, they make an unstoppable team!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Tina
programme.desc: Tired of being told what to do, Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend Tina to show Mum and Dad who's boss. Now they can do anything they want, until Mum and Dad rebel.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Driving
programme.desc: With only five minutes to play 'Driving', Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.

programme.desc: The Squirrels want to help Plinky find her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: Roly reveals he's expecting a new baby brother or sister, and the Squirrels have questions.

programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch has travelled to Ilulissat in Greenland to show his teddy, Cuddles, the sights. But Cuddles ends up getting stuck in the snow!

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - The Claw
programme.desc: When Bluey and Bingo are unable to grab a prize on a Magic Claw machine, Mum and Dad create their own version at home. But Dad isn't about to make winning easy.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Bus
programme.desc: During a game of bus, passenger Mum is too shy to tell bus driver Dad that she secretly loves him, until she gets some help from the Grannies.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Granny Mobile
programme.desc: Muffin is playing Grouchy Granny at a garage sale, making Dad push her on an old mobility scooter, but when a real Grouchy Granny wants to buy it, Muffin won't budge.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Space
programme.desc: Mackenzie, Jack and Rusty are playing as astronauts on a mission to Mars, but during their journey, Mackenzie keeps going missing and no one knows why, not even Mackenzie.

programme.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures (S1) - Andy and the Flamingos
programme.desc: In South America, Andy spots flamingos in a mountain lake and sets about painting them.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Gloves
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Fortress of Fun, where Kingsley and Queenie play a fun game of 'Wavey Wavey Snap' using some giant, silly gloves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Music Video Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having fun playing a song they made, but they wish that they could see themselves perform. Duggee has a great suggestion, and they learn how to be creative.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The List Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Wish Badge

programme.desc: Tinky Winky and Laa-Laa are in Home Dome when the Tubby Phone rings. It's Dipsy and Po calling from the Tubby Mobile to say 'Hello'.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from "Fake Ghost Catchers" Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become "The Five Shaolin Masters".

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score "The Proud One". Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies' youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Sword Stained with Royal Blood
programme.desc: Adapted from Jin Yong's novel, the movie depicts the havoc breaking out in the martial arts world when a warrior on the run uncovers a sword, a training manual, a treasure map and a secret message on the body of a deceased martial arts master.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A Wu Dang disciple Fu, kills the chief of Wu Dang Clan and frames it on the chief's illegitimate child, Yun. Fu then proclaims himself the new chief and orders the killing of Yun, who vows to avenge his father's death and learns the invincible silkworm martial arts style in order to defeat Fu.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue...

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.
